coauthors.name: Qing Xiao
coauthors.affiliation: Human-Computer Interaction Institute, Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA, USA
coauthors.relevance_evidence: Co-lead of 'User-Driven Value Alignment' (2409.00862), which introduces 'the concept of user-driven value alignment, where users actively identify, challenge, and attempt to correct AI outputs they perceive as harmful, aiming to guide the AI to better align with their values' for LLM-based AI companions; also on Minion (2411.07042) on negotiating 'harmful value conflicts' with LLM companions. Directly about values/value alignment in LLMs.

coauthors.name: Xuhui Zhou
coauthors.affiliation: Language Technologies Institute, Carnegie Mellon University, Pittsburgh, PA, USA
coauthors.relevance_evidence: NLP author on 'User-Driven Value Alignment' (2409.00862) and Minion (2411.07042): 'Large language model-based AI companions ... can generate biased, discriminatory, and harmful outputs' and users' 'seven user-driven alignment strategies'. Work is on social/value alignment of LLMs, not generic bias.
